_meta.units: px (CSS px = Qt logical px at 1x; GTK scale factor multiplies)
notes: Values marked runtime_computed are not constants in CSS; implement the given algorithm.
High contrast (prefers-contrast: more) does NOT change the palette; it changes opacities, adds 1px borders (box-shadow inset) and focus ring alpha.
currentColor = the widget's own foreground colour at that moment; mixes are color-mix(in srgb, currentColor P%, transparent) = fg colour with alpha P.

standalone_algorithm.css: --accent-color: oklab(from var(--accent-bg-color) min(l,0.5) a b) [light]; max(l,0.85) [dark] (_colors.scss:25, :88; _palette block :152-160)
steps: L = dark ? max(L,0.85) : min(L,0.5); a,b unchanged
Oklab -> linear sRGB -> gamma (v>0.0031308 ? 1.055*v^(1/2.4)-0.055 : 12.92*v) -> clamp each channel to [0,1]; alpha unchanged
standalone_algorithm.osd_and_toast: inside .osd / toast / dark popovers-in-osd the dark variant (max(l,0.85)) is forced via --standalone-color-oklab (_common.scss:41, _misc.scss:44); toggle-group.osd checked forces light variant (_toggle-group.scss:111)

portal_mapping.input: org.freedesktop.appearance accent-color (ddd) r,g,b in 0..1; any component <0 or >1 (unset is -1) => BLUE
portal_mapping.algorithm: input is gamma-encoded sRGB; adw_rgb_to_oklch applies the sRGB EOTF -> linear -> Oklab -> OKLCH (C=hypot(a,b), h=atan2(b,a) in degrees, mod 360); then the first matching rule below (top to bottom)
portal_mapping.note: Lightness is ignored; mapping is by hue and chroma only. Result is one of the 9 palette entries; libadwaita never uses the arbitrary portal colour directly.

scheme_notes.hc-light/hc-dark: identical colour tokens to light/dark; only 'opacities' differ and widget rules marked hc
scheme_notes.light/dark switch: portal org.freedesktop.appearance color-scheme (1=dark) via AdwStyleManager; hc via portal 'contrast'==1 (adw-settings-impl-portal.c:169) or gsettings high-contrast

other_colors.headerbar_border_color_effective: headerbar-border-color @ border-opacity (headerbar fg colour with alpha)

spacing_scale_px.note: HIG/stylesheet use 6px base unit (box spacing 6, 12, 18, 24, 36) plus 3px half step

backdrop.effect: headerbar/sidebar bg to backdrop colour; content filter opacity(0.5)

transitions.disable: When gtk-enable-animations=false (portal/gsettings enable-animations), AdwStyleManager injects '* { transition: none; }' (adw-style-manager.c:475-478); temporarily applied ~ during style switch; Qt: skip all animations.

offset_rules.outer (suggested/opaque/osd buttons, swi: offset +1 (switch, opaque, osd) or 0 (toggle, tabgrid), extends outward

focus_ring.idle: outline 0 solid transparent, offset = (inner: -width? computed as offset+width+4px) so ring animates in from 4px

button.disabled: whole widget opacity = disabled-opacity (0.5; hc 0.4); flat disabled unchecked: 0.30

destructive.note: NOT a filled red button; filled only when combined with .suggested-action/.opaque

link.fg: accent-color underline; visited mix(accent 80%, view-fg); hover HSL(h, s*1.1, l*1.1)

button.hc: adds inset 0 0 0 1px border-color (0.5 alpha) around normal buttons; flat buttons only on hover/active/checked
button.linked: adjacent buttons: 0 radius on joined side, margin -1px overlap (_linked.scss)

switch.src: widgets/_switch.scss; size from GTK C (not in CSS)
switch.size_note: width = 2*slider + 2*padding, height = slider + 2*padding (GTK GtkSwitch layout, not in SCSS)

check_radio.unchecked: inset 2px ring currentColor 0.15 (hover 0.20; hc ring: border-color 0.5, hover 0.60); active: fill 0.25 (hc 0.60), ring none
check_radio.checked: fill accent-bg-color, glyph accent-fg-color (check.svg/bullet.svg/dash.svg), hover overlay currentColor 0.10, active rgb(0,0,6) 0.20

scale.highlight: accent-bg-color, fg accent-fg; hover overlay currentColor 0.10

scrollbar.geometry_note: Slider min thickness 8px + 8px transparent border and -8px margin (net 8px in trough). Overlay idle: trough margin 4px, slider 3px; overlay hovering (and non-overlay): slider 8px, trough margin 8px, trough bg currentColor 0.10 (hc 0.25) only for overlay. Overlay indicator state (hovering) is set by GTK at runtime on pointer proximity; idle bars fade out after GTK overlay timeout (GTK C, not CSS).

tab.indicator: inset 4px bar (box-shadow): checked accent-bg-color, hover border-color 0.15

headerbar.border_bottom: 1px (inside 47) inset 0 -1px headerbar-shade-color; hc: border color headerbar-border @0.5
headerbar.button_style: flat buttons for image/arrow/image-text buttons; linked buttons raised

windowcontrols.circle_px: icon 16 + padding 4*2 = 24; button min_width 24 + padding 5 => 34 hit area

popover_menu.arrow_pointer: popover > arrow: popover-bg-color bg, 1px transparent border (hc: border-color)

boxed_list.shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,6,0.03), 0 1px 3px 1px rgba(0,0,6,0.07), 0 2px 6px 2px rgba(0,0,6,0.03) (hc: first ring -> border-color 0.5)

default_font.note: libadwaita stylesheet itself sets no font-family; text uses gtk-font-name. 11pt = 14.67px at 96dpi

high_contrast.trigger: portal org.freedesktop.appearance contrast == 1 (GTK prefers-contrast: more) or gsettings org.gnome.desktop.a11y.interface high-contrast

changes.check_radio: unchecked ring uses border-color (0.5); hover ring 0.60; active fill 0.60

animations.setting: gtk-enable-animations / org.gnome.desktop.interface enable-animations (portal: reduced motion not separate in libadwaita 1.10)
